Task 0016: launch() spawns 'emulator @<avd>' (+ -no-window/-wipe-data/-no-snapshot-load/-gpu <mode> from LaunchOpts + extra_args -- flags cited from the official emulator-commandline docs, not invented), streams output lines onto the JobHandle, polls 'adb -s <serial> shell getprop sys.boot_completed' until '1' with a wall-clock DEFAULT_BOOT_TIMEOUT (300s, overridable via with_boot_timeout), and fast-fails if the emulator process exits (stream EOF) before boot. The spawned child is HELD in AndroidProvider.running (EmulatorId -> Arc<AsyncMutex<Box<dyn ChildProcess>>>) rather than dropped -- that's what lets stop() reap it ('never orphans') and keeps its stdout drained. stop() does graceful 'adb -s <serial> emu kill' (serial found by matching the registry avd_name against each 'adb -s <s> emu avd name'), waits up to DEFAULT_STOP_TIMEOUT (15s, overridable), then force-kills the held child; idempotent when nothing's running, NotFound for an unknown id. grpc_port left None (M3 detail-panel work). Testing-infra addition in emu-core: FakeProcessRunner::on_spawn_lingering + a FakeChild 'lingering' flag (next_line never resolves after scripted lines, until kill) so the pure timeout path -- stream open, boot never completes -- is testable; a general fake improvement, not a one-off. emu-android tokio deps gained 'time'+'sync' features (no 'rt' -- runs on the caller's runtime). 8 new emu-android tests (launch happy/streams/exits-before-boot/timeout, stop emu-kill/idempotent/unknown-id/force-kill) -- 109 rust tests total in just validate, green. No IPC surface touched, bindings.ts regenerated as a no-op diff.
